comment: B10 (2026-11-14): destinations where travel/medical insurance is factually required, transcribed from monetization-audit-2026-11-13/b10-insurance-required/VERIFIED-LIST.md (main list only; (c) and appendix entries excluded). Copy from SLOT-COPY.md with the trailing source parenthesis stripped — the source renders as a link. officialOnly=true means the requirement can only be met by an official/designated policy (QA/SA/KE/TZ): those pages get the factual checklist line only, never a 'meets the requirement' note on a commercial card. Schengen cardNote is null on purpose: SLOT-COPY conditions the 'Meets' line on confirming SafetyWing's current product covers >=EUR 30,000 incl. repatriation across all Schengen states; SafetyWing's own product page does not state that, so the checklist line runs alone (see build PROGRESS).

entries.note: Travel medical insurance is a required document for a Schengen visa application — at least €30,000 of cover, valid in all Schengen states for your whole stay.

entries.cardNote: Belarus requires at least €10,000 of medical cover — a policy can also be bought at the airport border checkpoint.
entries.note: Health insurance is required to get a Belarus visa and to cross the border — minimum cover €10,000, valid for your whole stay. It is checked at visa application and at entry.
entries.sourceName: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belarus

entries.note: A valid health and accident insurance policy covering your whole stay in Iran is one of the documents required to collect an Iranian visa.
entries.sourceName: Embassy of Iran — visa document list

entries.note: Russian consulates ask most visa applicants for a medical insurance policy valid across Russia for the whole visa period, with at least €30,000 of cover, unless a reciprocity arrangement exempts your nationality. Check the document list of the consulate handling your application.
Applicants with your passport must include travel insurance in the Algeria visa file — covering medical care and repatriation for the whole trip; the Paris consulate specifies at least €30,000.
A health insurance policy with at least €30,000 of cover is a required document for a Ukrainian visa, and missing insurance is a listed ground for refusal.
entries.sourceName: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine

entries.cutNote: The policy above is separate from Qatar's mandatory visitor scheme and does not replace it.
entries.note: If you need a visa before travel, Qatar will not issue it until you hold the official visitor health insurance policy (QAR 50 per 30 days, emergency cover up to QAR 150,000) from an insurer registered with the Ministry of Public Health. Visa-free and visa-on-arrival visitors are exempt for the first 30 days. Buy it through the MOPH portal: moph.gov.qa
Medical insurance is already included in the Saudi eVisa fee — the official portal adds a policy from a Saudi insurer automatically when you apply, and your own policy cannot be used in its place.

Since October 2026, Kenya requires visitors staying under 12 months to hold inbound travel health insurance from a Kenyan-licensed insurer — the eTA application cannot be completed without it, and foreign policies are not accepted in its place. It is sold inside the official eTA application at etakenya.go.ke (about US$44, 90 days).
For a sponsored UAE tourist visa, 'medical insurance valid in UAE' is on the official document list. Travellers entering visa-free or on arrival are not asked for it.

entries.cardNote: Cuba asks for proof of medical cover on entry — keep your policy document with your passport.
entries.note: Medical insurance is mandatory for all travellers entering Cuba, and you may be asked to show proof on arrival. If you arrive without acceptable cover, you will be directed to buy a policy from the state insurer ASISTUR at the airport.

Tanzania requires foreign visitors to buy the official inbound travel insurance — from the Zanzibar Insurance Corporation if you enter via Zanzibar, or the National Insurance Corporation if you enter via the mainland (US$44, covers up to 92 days). Your own travel insurance does not replace it. Official portals: inbound.visitzanzibar.go.tz · inbound.nicinsurance.co.tz
entries.sourceName: Zanzibar Insurance Corporation / National Insurance Corporation

entries.cardNote: Georgia's tourist insurance minimum is GEL 30,000 (about US$11,000) for the full stay.
entries.note: Since 1 January 2026, tourists entering Georgia must hold health and accident insurance of at least GEL 30,000 covering the whole trip. Border officers may check the policy.
entries.sourceName: Law of Georgia on Tourism; Government Decree No. 602

entries.note: Using Oman's 14-day visa exemption? Health insurance is one of its listed conditions, alongside a return ticket, a confirmed hotel booking and sufficient funds.

Argentine law (Decree 366/2025) requires arrivals to file a sworn declaration stating, among other things, that they hold health insurance for their medical needs during the stay. Separately, national public hospitals charge non-residents for non-emergency care unless they show insurance.
